known_deviations.source: VLDB 2022 TranAD; the two-phase transformer with focus-score self-conditioning is transcribed from github.com/imperial-qore/TranAD (src/models.py, main.py:backprop).
known_deviations.protocol_note: The release thresholds these scores with POT (src/pot.py: SPOT with the per-dataset lm_d and lr_d in src/params.json). This harness reports its percentile reference protocol here, and POT is applied separately by scripts/mtsad/score_pot.py, because folding a different threshold rule into the model comparison would confound the two.
known_deviations.precision_boundary: Old float32 and new float64 results need separate names. Float32 overflow at SMAP high-scale test inputs is reproducible; numerical precision is not generally monotone-equivalent. Full original local model/budget/data retained; author padding/preprocessing/POT/environment remain separate.

boundary: Full float64 training/scoring precision control on unchanged original local registered datasets, seeds, windows and budgets. Not an exact retry of float32 or a complete historical author/TAB pipeline. Frozen input arrays still retain their original prepared precision; no rescaling or new preprocessing.
